lines: In a world packed with people like nuts in a bag
Everyone is leaning on the person they met
We who slipped in are like peanuts
While pretending to be nuts, we wear a smile
On the template of happiness
Literally the painted surface behind the picture
Even when we gather around the table and join hands
We cannot be ourselves, staying as we are
A home full of secrets and patchwork, you know?
Even when we chew it up, it doesn't disappear
Our true feelings stay stuck between our teeth
A life full of anxiety, left to chance, and I know
It's a daily life covered in pretense, though
Here I am, and you are here
Just this truth makes my stomach swell
Like a single peeled peanut
When society instantly rejects you, that's the moment
If being crooked is okay, let me stay by your side
Together we are roasted, shaken, even stepped on
Because we become like an unbreakable shell
Whether we were born on a tree or in the ground
That's the only difference
In this unforgivable dry world
May the rain moisten it equally
Sometimes cold and noisy beyond the window, you know?
Not a single star can be found
Even a day full of thunder would be fine
A show full of mistakes and improvisation, but I know
After all, it's just a day of one-off things
I'll let it flow into my gut and sleep
A home full of secrets and patchwork, you know?
While devouring everything without leaving any special or ready-made behind
There is no normal, there is no correct answer, life, and I know
It's a daily life covered in pretense, though
Here I am, and you are here
Just this truth makes my stomach swell, whoa
I'll savor this handful of miracle
